decisions.reason: As an air-quality sensing module that stays close to the firm's established sensor, firmware, and API knowledge base, we can continue learning from user demand and improve it, so withdrawal risk remains limited.

Because this voltage-measurement module is a direct continuation of an existing product line and rests on very strong prior technical and commercial knowledge, it is highly likely to remain in the portfolio.

The MQTT proxy still fits our software and connectivity capabilities, but as a complementary software tool with potentially narrower standalone demand it has a somewhat higher discontinuation risk than core hardware modules.
The CAN bus interface remains well aligned with our modular embedded-communication platform and with industrial customer applications, giving us good scope to refine and support it further.

The carbon-dioxide sensor module fits squarely within our sensing portfolio and can benefit from our existing electronics, firmware, and documentation capabilities, although sensor-specific component changes create some replacement risk over time.
